how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-western-plaguelands-03-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

Kill them, and we're making progress. They should be along Hearthglen Pass outside the town proper.

rows.quest:5804:details:0: Araj the Summoner lords over Andorhal from the ruined city's heart. We know that he was the former leader of ⟦E54⟧ before claiming the city as his own. To finish the key, we will need his signet - called a scarab - mounted as the head of the key.

rows.quest:5861:obj:0: ⟦E37⟧ to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern ⟦E26⟧. Show ⟦E60⟧ ⟦E61⟧.
rows.quest:5861:details:0: ⟦65⟧, you have done all that I have asked thus far. Only one step remains in your quest of redemption.
rows.quest:5861:details:1: You must deliver the items you have collected to Taelan. Unfortunately, Taelan and his ⟦E62⟧ Crusaders will attack you on sight.
rows.quest:5861:details:2: There is only one way in which to deliver my message and that is through a guise of deception.
rows.quest:5861:details:3: To the south you will find Uther's tomb. An old and trusted confidant of mine, Myranda, now resides there - seek her out. Show her the items and she will assist you.
rows.quest:5861:progress:0: I knew this day would come.
rows.quest:5861:completion:0: I was Tirion's most trusted advisor when he held rank as Lord of Mardenholde. I openly dissented the verdict passed by the Order of the Silver Hand and was banished for my insolence.
rows.quest:5861:completion:1: He has been through much heart ache and disappointment in his life, ⟦66⟧. Are you prepared to right the wrongs set upon the Fordrings?
rows.quest:5862:obj:0: Speak to Myranda to gain the ⟦E62⟧ Illusion. ⟦E37⟧ to Hearthglen while under the ⟦E62⟧ Illusion and deliver ⟦E61⟧ to ⟦E64⟧.
rows.quest:5862:obj:1: Hearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.
rows.quest:5862:details:0: I am what you would call, an illusionist. Though I may be able to create an illusion to allow you entry into Hearthglen, be warned; my powers have their limitations.
rows.quest:5862:details:1: Should you travel too far from these lands, the effects of the illusion will cease. The spell itself takes a great amount of concentration and power from me, and thus, I can only sustain the effect for a short time.
rows.quest:5862:details:2: Speak to me again when you are ready.
rows.quest:5862:progress:0: Are you the reinforcements from Tyr's Hand?
rows.quest:5862:completion:1: B<Taelan opens the box and begins to examine its contents.>
rows.quest:5862:completion:2: This... this cannot be true. But all that you have shown me...
rows.quest:5862:completion:3: B<Taelan falls to one knee, his heartbeat quickens. The fury of ages is about to be loosed upon this town.>
rows.quest:5944:obj:0: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.
rows.quest:5944:details:0: For so long, I have been a puppet of the Grand Crusader. What reason was there to fight against what the ⟦E5⟧ had become? It has been decades, yet the memories of my father; those precious memories, they are what have kept me alive.
rows.quest:5944:details:1: I have dreams, stranger. In these dreams my father is with me. He stands proudly at my side as I am inducted into the Order. We battle legion of Scourge, side by side. We bring honor to the ⟦E20⟧, to Lordaeron.
rows.quest:5944:details:2: I want not to dream anymore.
rows.quest:5944:completion:0: The death of my son at the hands of these monsters will not pass without incident. Take solace in knowing that the Order is reborn.
rows.quest:5944:completion:1: I now take my place as Highlord of the new Order of the Silver Hand.
rows.quest:5944:completion:2: These possessions of my past - they are all that I have to offer for all that you have done. Please, take these as a symbol of my gratitude; all have served me well over the years.
rows.quest:5944:completion:3: May we meet again, in better times, and reminisce of days long past... battles hard fought... dreams redeemed.
